name: typecheck
description: Run the workspace typechecker (currently Bun/TSC) and return its diagnostics. Runs a single fixed command with no model-chosen arguments, no network, and no installs. A non-zero exit code is a normal result to read and iterate on, not an error.

detailed: Runs type checking on the workspace.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
